purpose: Typed P2-TRACE-01 graph joining masterplan volumes, canonical requirements, capabilities, behaviors, machine authorities and executable validation.

policy.dangling_rule: Every edge endpoint exists exactly once.
policy.requirement_rule: Every requirement traces to its volume, one or more capabilities, and executable test evidence.
policy.behavior_rule: Every behavior traces to requirement(s) and test.
policy.impact_rule: Incident edges permit deterministic changed-authority expansion to affected requirements/volumes.
policy.no_false_completion: Trace completeness does not imply masterplan maturity or signoff.
policy.capability_id_rule: Capability node IDs use the taxonomy Unicode code-point ordering algorithm.

masterplan_binding.title: Master Traceability Matrix
required_gap_texts: bind PR impact checks to trace edges
